shots.name: wt-tsunami
script: window.__GENESIS_FX__.fx.hand.force = false; const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const p = G.poi('coast');
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'weather.clear' });
await G.camera({ mode: 'surface', poi: 'coast', alt: 14, yaw: p.heading, pitch: 0, fov: 65, hour: 10.5 }); await G.frames(2);

const R = F.fx.ctx.pv.params.radius; const c = F.fx.vis.camBody.clone().normalize(); const f = F.fx.camFwd.clone(); f.addScaledVector(c, -f.dot(c)).normalize(); const o = c.clone().addScaledVector(f, 950 / R).normalize();
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.disaster', kind: 'tsunami', pos: [o.x, o.y, o.z], progress: 0.62, radius: 420, intensity: 1.5 });
await G.step(1); await G.frames(2); F.advance(6); await G.frames(4);

shots.name: wt-tsunami-top
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const st = [...F.fx.m.disasters.states.values()].find((x) => x.kind === 'tsunami');
const p = G.poi('coast'); await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', lat: p.lat, lon: p.lon, dist: 700, tilt: 45, yaw: p.heading, hour: 10.5 }); await G.frames(6);
